item.title: WISH 8 summit opens in Doha tomorrow with health ministry partnership
item.description:
The eighth World Innovation Summit for Health (WISH) opens tomorrow, Sunday, at Qatar National Convention Centre for two days under the theme "The New Health Span". The Qatar Foundation summit announced a strategic partnership with the Ministry of Public Health, including a joint report on the returns of healthy longevity to be unveiled there. The Lancet Commission on Attacks on Health will launch its report at the summit, alongside an exhibition on attacks on healthcare in Palestine.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/وزارة-الصحة-العامة-شريك-استراتيجي-للنسخة-الثامنة-من-قمة-ويش · Al Jazeera Net https://www.aljazeera.net/health/2026/11/28/%d8%a3%d8%a8%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%ab-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b4%d9%8a%d8%ae%d9%88%d8%ae%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%b7%d8%a8-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b3%d8%aa%d9%82%d8%a8%d9%84-%d9%85%d8%a7%d8%b0%d8%a7 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739129/qatar/wish-set-to-focus-on-attacks-on-healthcare-collaboration-agreements

item.title: Nasser Al Attiyah wins sixth Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge
item.description:
Qatar's Nasser Saleh Al Attiyah won the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge for a sixth time and a third in a row, taking the 35th edition, which ended on Friday, with Belgian navigator Fabian Lurquin in a combined 12 hours, 53 minutes and 5 seconds. He finished 2 minutes 44 seconds ahead of French team-mate Sébastien Loeb, but lost the World Rally-Raid Championship by five points to American Seth Quintero, while Dacia took the manufacturers' title.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/28/11/2026/al-attiyah-clinches-sixth-abu-dhabi-desert-challenge-title · FIA https://www.fia.com/news/toyotas-quintero-and-short-secure-w2rc-drivers-and-navigators-titles-35th-abu-dhabi-desert · Dacia (press release) https://media.dacia.com/the-dacia-sandriders-signs-off-on-top-of-the-world-in-abu-dhabi/?lang=eng

item.title: Over 1,000 startups confirm for Web Summit Qatar 2027
item.description:
More than 1,000 startups and over 370 investors have confirmed for the fourth Web Summit Qatar in 2027, the permanent organising committee heard at a meeting chaired by Sheikh Jassim bin Mansour bin Jabor al-Thani, Director of the Government Communications Office. Signed partnerships have passed 120, including first-timers Visa and Hewlett Packard Enterprise, confirmed media professionals have tripled to 275, and Bloomberg Media and CNN have joined as media partners.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739141/qatar/growing-global-interest-for-web-summit-qatar-27 · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/120-شريكا-عالميا-في-قمة-الويب-قطر-2027

item.title: Doha Film Festival closes, crowning Concrete Land and A Girl Unknown
item.description:
Doha Film Festival 2026 closed after nine days by announcing the winners of its four competitions, in the presence of Sheikha Al-Mayassa bint Hamad Al-Thani, Chairperson of the Doha Film Institute. Concrete Land by Asmahan Bkerat won Best Documentary and the FIPRESCI Prize, A Girl Unknown by Zou Jing won Best Narrative, and Hamad Al-Fayhani's Crawling Into Myself took Best Film in the Made in Qatar competition. Prizes totalled more than $300,000.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/28/11/2026/doha-film-festival-2026-concludes-honours-bold-storytelling · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/اختتام-فعاليات-مهرجان-الدوحة-السينمائي-2026-بتتويج-الفائزين · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739088/qatar/dff-2026-exceeds-expectations-as-dfi-leads-next-steps-for-regional-cinema

item.title: Qatari trade mission to Bahrain yields QR172mn in potential deals
item.description:
Qatar Exports, part of Qatar Development Bank, concluded its trade mission to Bahrain with more than 350 B2B meetings between over 40 Qatari companies and Bahraini importers and distributors, yielding potential deals worth QR172mn. Sectors included building materials, paints, consumer goods, packaging, food and electrical cables. Bilateral trade reached about QR2.54bn in 2025, compared with about QR10.3mn in 2021.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/qatar-exports-concludes-trade-mission-to-bahrain · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/28/صادرات-قطر-تختتم-فعاليات-البعثة-التجارية-القطرية-إلى-البحرين · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266813/latest-news/qatar-exports-concludes-trade-mission-to-bahrain

item.title: Qatari Businessmen Association explores partnerships with Wallonia delegation
item.description:
The Qatari Businessmen Association discussed ways to boost economic and investment cooperation with a Belgian delegation led by Adrien Dolimont, Minister-President of Wallonia, joined by the president of the Royal Belgian Football Association and Belgium's ambassador. Talks focused on partnerships in energy, advanced industries, technology, logistics, healthcare, tourism and the sports economy. The Belgian ambassador had earlier reaffirmed the partnership with Qatar at a reception attended by Dolimont and the environment minister.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/qba-belgian-delegation-explore-avenues-for-economic-and-investment-cooperation · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/28/11/2026/رابطة-رجال-الأعمال-القطريين-تبحث-مع-وفد-بلجيكي-تعزيز-التعاون-الاقتصادي-والاستثماري · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266688/nation/belgium-reaffirms-strong-partnership-with-qatar-amid-global-challenges

item.title: Coalition intercepts new Houthi missiles at southern Saudi Arabia, vows response
item.description:
The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Saudi Arabia's southern region, then a third aimed at Al-Shuqaiq in Jazan, whose debris fell without casualties. Spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said attacks on civilians would be met firmly. The Arab League condemned the strikes on the Jazan refinery and port, while Yemeni government forces said they carried out 726 attacks on Houthi positions in 24 hours.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/coalition-air-defenses-intercept-destroy-two-ballistic-missiles-launched-by-toward-saudi-arabias-southern-region · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666588/saudi-arabia/saudi-air-defenses-intercept-cruise-missile-fired-by-houthi-militia-toward-riyadh-region · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/التحالف-اعتراض-وتدمير-صاروخ-باليستي-أطلقه-حوثيون-تجاه-الشقيق-وسيتم/7635683 · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/arab-league-condemns-houthi-attacks-on-saudi-arabia · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/yemen-governmen-forces-hit-houthi-positions-as-un-warns-of-hunger-crisis

item.title: Italy says Iranian-made drone killed two technicians in Kuwait
item.description:
Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said investigations showed the drone that killed two Italian technicians at a Kuwaiti military facility on Thursday was made in Iran, though that did not necessarily mean it was launched from Iranian territory. Tehran denied any role, called it a "false flag" operation and offered a joint inquiry with Kuwait and Italy. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemned the attack and urged all parties to exercise restraint.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/iran-points-to-europes-war-role-after-italians-killed-in-kuwait-strike · Arab Times (ANSA) https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/iran-made-drone-killed-two-italian-technicians-in-kuwait/ · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/un-secretary-general-condemns-drone-attack-targeting-kuwait

item.title: Makkah alliance pledges stronger support for Saudi security after Islamabad talks
item.description:
Pakistan and Turkiye pledged in a joint statement after the second meeting of the Makkah alliance's Strategic Political and Defence Committee in Islamabad to continue and ramp up support for Saudi Arabia's security, condemning Houthi attacks on civilians and infrastructure. The three states welcomed the start of the alliance's General Secretariat in Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed defence-industry cooperation. Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman met Field Marshal Asim Munir to discuss strengthening both countries' military capabilities.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739149/region/makkah-defence-coalition-vows-to-step-up-efforts-to-bolster-saudi-arabias-security · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666586/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-pakistan-to-strengthen-bilateral-defense-capabilities · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/makkah-defense-coalition-vows-to-step-up-efforts-to-bolster-saudi-arabias-security

item.title: Oman producer prices jump 24.8% as Muscat bourse hits four-month low
item.description:
Oman's Producer Price Index rose 24.8% year on year in the third quarter of 2026, led by refined petroleum products, up 61%, and manufacturing, up 31.7%, the National Centre for Statistics and Information said. On the market, the Muscat Stock Exchange main index fell 71 points over the week to 7,188, a four-month low, and market capitalisation dropped about OMR175mn to OMR38.673bn.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/omans-producer-prices-jump-248-in-q3-2026 · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179683-omans-producer-price-index-rises-248-in-q3-2026 · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/msx-market-value-drops-omr-175-million-to-omr-38673-billion

item.title: Bootleg alcohol poisoning wave in Iran kills more than 20
item.description:
A wave of methanol-contaminated bootleg alcohol poisoning in Iran has killed more than 20 people since mid-November and sickened over 500 in Fars, Hormozgan, Razavi Khorasan and West Azerbaijan provinces, some of whom were blinded. Police have arrested about 10 people, and the Razavi Khorasan prosecutor said the cases are linked to a single distribution network. The head of Iran's psychiatric association warned that some alcohol is being poisoned deliberately.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/bootleg-alcohol-poisonings-in-iran-see-dozens-dead-and-badly-injured · Iran International https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611277112

item.title: Thirty Warraq crash victims identified through DNA
item.description:
The Ministry of Health and Population, working with the Forensic Medicine Authority and the Public Prosecution, said it had identified 30 victims of the fire involving a fuel truck on the Ring Road in Warraq using DNA. The ministry sent psychological support teams to hospitals and set up the 24-hour hotline 16328. The Ministry of Social Solidarity said it would announce the final tally of compensation and donations at a press conference after contributions close on Sunday evening.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/الصحة-تحديد-هوية-30-من-ضحايا-حادث-الوراق-باستخدام-البصمة/7635464 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085869 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197625

item.title: Dar al-Ifta rules that violating traffic rules is religiously forbidden
item.description:
Egypt's Dar al-Ifta said in a statement that obeying traffic rules is a religious and national duty and that violating them is forbidden, with the sin growing in proportion to the harm caused to lives. It cited driving against traffic, running signals and speeding as violations carrying religious and legal liability, invoking the aims of preserving life and property and the principle of "no harm". The statement comes on the eve of an extraordinary cabinet meeting on road accidents.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/دار-الإفتاء-تحسم-حكم-مخالفة-قوانين-المرور-حرام-شرعًا-وتعرض/7635384 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085809 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197642

item.title: Madbouly inspects Shamla bridge and Nasser hospital in Beni Suef
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly, concluding his Beni Suef tour, inspected the Shamla bridge over the Azmy level crossing, the Ibrahimiya canal and the Cairo–Aswan railway. Transport Minister Kamel al-Wazir said it is part of a plan for 54 bridges over the most dangerous crossings, 36 of them completed at a cost of about EGP15bn. At Nasser General Hospital, the health minister said the governorate has 1,214 beds in 12 hospitals, with three more under completion.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/رئيس-الوزراء-يتفقد-أعمال-مشروع-إنشاء-كوبرى-الشاملة-بالمدخل-الشمالى/7635568 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_regions/details/2026/11/28/3085860 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085859

item.title: Gold pound near EGP46,500 after global bullion gains
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt held steady on Saturday with global markets closed for the weekend; 21-carat traded at about EGP5,810 to sell and EGP5,760 to buy, and 24-carat at about EGP6,640. The gold pound ranged between EGP46,460 and EGP46,560, more than EGP4,000 below its October peak above EGP50,800. Bullion had risen about 2.4% globally on Friday to near $3,653 an ounce, according to Bloomberg data.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197491 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/28/3085735

item.title: Saddam Haftar announces framework to unify Libyan institutions
item.description:
Saddam Haftar, deputy commander-in-chief of the Libyan armed forces, announced a comprehensive framework to unify the executive and state institutions, paving the way from negotiation to implementation and towards renewed legitimacy and an end to the transitional period. He praised the efforts of the UN mission and supporting states, including Egypt, saying openness to partners stems from an independent national vision that does not harm existing relations.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197611 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5780104

item.title: Kunar blast toll in Afghanistan rises to at least 10 students
item.description:
The toll from a blast beside a middle school in Asadabad, in Afghanistan's eastern Kunar province, on Saturday morning has risen to 10 students killed and about 110 injured, the Interior Ministry said. The explosion happened in an adjacent house where people involved in mining stored dynamite, and ministry spokesman Abdul Mateen Qani said initial investigations point to negligence.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/students-killed-injured-in-school-explosion-in-afghanistans-kunar-region · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666589/world/7-students-killed-nearly-100-injured-in-school-blast-in-afghanistan

item.title: KMT keeps Taipei as ruling DPP retakes Taichung in Taiwan polls
item.description:
Opposition Kuomintang candidate Chiang Wan-an retained the Taipei mayoralty in Taiwan's local elections on Saturday after his rival from the ruling Democratic Progressive Party conceded. The DPP retook Taichung, the second most populous city, ending eight years of KMT rule, along with Tainan and Kaohsiung. A nuclear power referendum passed in a vote covering some 11,000 posts and closely watched by China.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/taiwan-opposition-party-wins-re-election-in-taipei-mayoral-race · Focus Taiwan (CNA) https://focustaiwan.tw/politics/202611280031 · Focus Taiwan (CNA) https://focustaiwan.tw/politics/202611280030

item.title: Spain votes tomorrow in snap election that could bring far right into government
item.description:
More than 38.6 million Spaniards are eligible to vote tomorrow, Sunday, in a snap general election, after a day of reflection today. Polls suggest the conservative People's Party will come first without a majority and need far-right Vox to reach 176 of 350 seats, while Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez seeks a new term after eight years in power. Housing, immigration and corruption allegations dominated the campaign.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/two-visions-of-spain-collide-as-voters-weigh-sanchez-record · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/28/spain-heads-into-decisive-election-as-campaigning-falls-silent

item.title: Law of the Sea tribunal rejects Argentina bid to halt Falklands drilling
item.description:
The International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea in Hamburg on Saturday voted 18-3 to reject Argentina's request for provisional measures to halt the $2.1bn Sea Lion offshore oil project near the Falkland Islands. Judges found Buenos Aires's claims could not be addressed without determining sovereignty over the archipelago, a matter outside the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea. Britain welcomed the decision.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (AFP, Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/court-rejects-argentinas-request-to-stop-uk-oil-activity-near-falklands · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/28/argentina-loses-bid-to-halt-oil-drilling-off-falkland-islands

item.title: Israeli strike on MSF clinic in Gaza kills two staff
item.description:
Two guards working for Doctors Without Borders (MSF) were killed in an Israeli strike on one of its clinics near Al-Shifa complex in western Gaza City; MSF called it a "direct hit" on premises marked with its logos and known to the Israeli military, and demanded accountability. Its staff killed in Gaza now number 17. The war's toll in Gaza has reached 74,790 dead and 176,336 wounded, including 1,720 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/israeli-strike-on-doctors-without-borders-clinic-in-gaza-kills-two-staff · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/msf-calls-for-accountability-after-israeli-occupation-kills-2-staff-members-in-gaza · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/death-toll-from-israeli-aggression-against-gaza-rises-to-74790-with-176336-wounded

item.title: S&P cuts France outlook to negative
item.description:
S&P Global cut the outlook on France's sovereign rating from stable to negative while keeping it at A+, forecasting a deficit of 5.3% of GDP in 2027 and continued growth in debt. Economy Minister Roland Lescure called it "a warning" that a budget must be passed, after the National Assembly rejected the first part of the 2027 draft budget.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/28/frances-credit-outlook-cut-to-negative-by-sp-economy-minister-calls-it-warning · Al Jazeera Net (Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.net/ebusiness/2026/11/28/%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%a7%d9%86%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%af-%d8%a2%d9%86%d8%af-%d8%a8%d9%88%d8%b1%d8%b2-%d8%aa%d8%ae%d9%81%d8%b6-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%b1%d8%a9

item.title: Clashes in Tirana as protesters demand Albanian PM's resignation
item.description:
Clashes broke out on Saturday in the Albanian capital, Tirana, between police and thousands of protesters demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation; police used tear gas and water cannon against demonstrators who threw stones and tried to smash cameras and government windows. The protest coincided with the 114th anniversary of independence and continues a series that began in late May over a luxury tourism project on the southern coast.
Sources: Euronews (AP) https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/28/albania-protesters-call-for-pm-resignation-amid-clashs · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197596
